question: Should maintainers keep this stale conflicting branch open for contributor proof, close it in favor of the canonical issue, or sponsor a refreshed replacement?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but this exact branch is not a safe landing candidate without maintainer choice because it is conflicting, proof-missing, and semantically too broad.

options.title: Request a refreshed branch
options.body: Ask for a current-main refresh that implements the documented list/status flows and adds after-fix Control UI proof before review resumes.

options.title: Close this PR, keep the issue
options.body: Close the stale branch while preserving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46894 as the canonical tracker for a new implementation.

options.title: Maintainer-sponsored replacement
options.body: A maintainer can open or adopt a replacement fix if the issue remains important and contributor proof is unlikely to arrive.

recommendation.title: Request a refreshed branch
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main refresh that implements the documented list/status flows and adds after-fix Control UI proof before review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-command and Control UI model-ref work makes this the best available routing owner among the history candidates.
